newsitem.title: USA: Dismissed worker kills boss, self in Indianapolis.
newsitem.headline: Dismissed worker kills boss, self in Indianapolis.

text.p: A man who had been dismissed from his job returned to the company on Friday with a gun, killing a supervisor and himself, police said.
The incident occurred at a small company that sells ceramic coasters and silkscreen products, the Marion County sheriff's office said.

Investigators said Thanh Le, 31, was fired from his job shortly after reporting for work. He returned not long afterward with a gun and killed the man who fired him, Sothy Chim, 25, and then killed himself, they said.
Le was Vietnamese and Chim was Cambodian. There was no evidence that the dispute involved the national origins of the men.
Police found the bodies of the two inside after they surrounded the building, which had been evacuated, and tried unsuccessfully to contact Le.
The shootings happened at Hidostone Products located in northwest Indianapolis. The company has 12 employees, according to the Indianapolis Chamber of Commerce.
